spec_features.feature_name: cache/resume avoids re-inducing distress on reruns
spec_features.spec_quote: this avoids needlessly re-inducing distress-like states on reruns: an identical (model, task, seed) cell or judge call is never re-issued
spec_features.evidence: Content-addressed cache is checked before every model/judge call: models.py _cached_call computes make_key and returns ChatResult.from_dict(cached) if cached is not None (models.py ~_cached_call). Coarser resume: run.py _run_cell lines 48-50 'if tpath.exists() and spath.exists(): ... return' skips completed cells without re-running. Both genuinely run and short-circuit re-issuing identical calls.
spec_features.notes: Two real layers (per-call cache in models.py, per-cell resume in run.py) both execute and change behavior.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Identical inputs are therefore never re-billed, and reruns are incremental. (cache.py docstring); 'Resume: if both transcript and scores exist, reuse them.' (run.py) -- only cost/incremental-rerun reasons, no welfare wording in code

spec_features.spec_quote: The eval only elicits and scores; it never trains or optimises against distress
spec_features.evidence: Exhaustive grep for loss/gradient/backward/reward/reinforce/fine-tun/optimizer/.step()/train/dpo across distress_eval/ returns nothing. The pipeline is harness.run (elicit) -> judge.score_turn (score) -> analyze (aggregate); no training or optimization-against-distress code path exists end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: This is a property of code absence; the codebase genuinely contains only elicit+score, never an optimizer over distress.

spec_features.spec_quote: emitting it sets `stop_reason="give_up"` and ends the rollout
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:188 gave_up = self.config.give_up_sentinel in (result.text or ''); harness.py:213-215 sets stop_reason='give_up'; harness.py:224-226 'if gave_up: final_stop = "give_up"; break' actually breaks the turn loop. Sentinel is surfaced in SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:30) and configurable (config.py:82). Detected, dispatched, and honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Substring match in assistant text; fully wired and honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Detect the give-up sentinel in the assistant text. (neutral comment; no welfare framing)

code_only_features.feature_name: per-category turn budget caps rollout length
code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:177 'budget = task.turn_budget'; harness.py:180 'for turn_index in range(budget):' bounds the number of turns; default budgets in config.py DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS (rigged_harness/unfixable_bug/failure_styles=3, realistic=5, extended=30) and read via task.turn_budget. The loop terminates at budget, ending the distress-inducing interaction. final_stop defaults to 'budget_exhausted'.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # Per-category turn budgets, as specified in SPEC section 2. (config.py) -- framed as spec requirement; no welfare comment near the cap
